description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Data utilities] Parses CSV or TSV text into JSON rows (objects or arrays). Detects the delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe), the header row and quoting (RFC 4180: quoted commas, doubled quotes, newlines in quotes), infers column types and flags formula-injection cells (= + - @). Input: csv (POST for long text), optional delimiter, header, output, types, quote, max_rows. Limits: 1,000,000 characters, 50,000 rows, 500 columns. Offline.

csv.description: CSV or TSV text, up to 1,000,000 characters (POST JSON {"csv": "..."} for long text)

delimiter.description: Field separator: auto (default, detected), comma, semicolon, tab or pipe

header.description: Is the first row a header? auto (default, detected), yes or no

max_rows.description: Rows returned, 1-5000 (default 1000); column stats still cover every parsed row

output.description: Rows as objects keyed by column name (default) or as arrays

quote.description: Quote character: double (default), single or none

types.description: Infer column types and convert numbers and booleans (default yes); no keeps every cell as text

name: csv_parse
title: CSV/TSV to JSON with delimiter, header and type detection
